description: gzip, deflate (zlib) or raw-deflate text to Base64 or hex, and decompress it back. Operations: "compress" — Compress UTF-8 text with gzip, deflate (zlib) or raw deflate.; "decompress" — Decompress Base64 or hex gzip/deflate data back to text (output up to 256 KB).. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: compress: The text to compress. decompress: The compressed bytes, as Base64 or hex.

operation.description: compress — Compress UTF-8 text with gzip, deflate (zlib) or raw deflate. decompress — Decompress Base64 or hex gzip/deflate data back to text (output up to 256 KB).

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

algorithm.description: compress: gzip (RFC 1952), deflate = zlib (RFC 1950) or deflate-raw (RFC 1951). decompress: auto reads the format from the first bytes. Used by: compress, decompress.

encoding.description: How the compressed bytes are written. Used by: compress, decompress.

name: compress
title: Gzip & Deflate Compressor
